name: refund-copilot-workspace
description: AI refund copilot for e-commerce support: the model reads and proposes, code prices and checks policy, people approve. Plus an MCP server that keeps coding agents on the real design system and API contract.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/mcp-server && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api --workspace=apps/refund-copilot" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/refund-copilot"
scripts.dev:refunds: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api --workspace=apps/refund-copilot" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/refund-copilot"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api:stub --workspace=apps/refund-copilot" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/refund-copilot"
